name: 11ai-directors
description: Director skills that wrap a task in a full workflow: setup, execution, quality checks, and reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Wrap a task in a disciplined workflow.
interface.longDescription: A director does not do the task. It wraps one: it establishes preconditions, hands the work to a task skill, quality-checks the result, reports what happened, and stops cleanly when the work becomes unmanageable. Pair a director with any skill that does the work itself.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me use the 11ai-directors skills to wrap this task in a disciplined workflow.
